summary.text: Mark D. Obenshain is a Republican member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 2, which covers all of Bath County, Highland County, Page County, Rockingham County and Harrisonburg City, and parts of Augusta County, and has served in the Senate since 2004.
Obenshain sits on the Senate committees on Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Commerce and Labor; Courts of Justice; and Finance and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Mark D. Obenshain was born in Richmond, Virginia on June 11, 1962, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Obenshain's education as Virginia Tech (B.A., 1984) and Washington and Lee University School of Law (J.D., 1987).
The profile gives Obenshain's occupation as principal with Obenshain Law Group.

Memberships and affiliations listed on the profile include Board of Directors, Harrisonburg Education Foundation; Board of Visitors, James Madison University 1995-2003; Mercy House, Inc., Board of Directors 1993-2006; Harrisonburg Rescue Squad, Inc., Business Advisory Board; Harrisonburg Rotary Club; Governor's Commission on Citizen Empowerment 1994-95.
